---
# Cisco IOS only. Same behavior as multi_vendor: VLAN-only when no interfaces; data-driven interfaces when intent has them.
# Variables: vlan_id, vlan_name, target_hosts, interfaces_config_with_vlan (from get_template_vars).
- name: Configure VLANs on access switches
  hosts: "Acc_Cisco_1,Acc_Cisco_2"
  gather_facts: no
  ignore_unreachable: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure VLAN 67 exists (Cisco IOS)
      cisco.ios.ios_vlans:
        config:
          - vlan_id: "67"
            name: "ShuYing"
            state: active
        state: merged
      when: inventory_hostname in groups.get('vendor_cisco_ios', [])


    - name: Configure interfaces (Cisco IOS)
      cisco.ios.ios_l2_interfaces:
        config:
          - name: Ethernet0/1
            mode: access
            access:
              vlan: '67'
          - name: Ethernet0/1
            mode: access
            access:
              vlan: '67'
          - name: Ethernet0/1
            mode: access
            access:
              vlan: '67'
        state: merged
      when: inventory_hostname in groups.get('vendor_cisco_ios', [])
